footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes $108K from other items, net.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Sep 30, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 19.0% to $5.0M in fiscal 2025 (ended Sep 30, 2025). Gross margin was 65.2%, versus 64.2% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $17.9M from $7.1M.
The net loss widened to $15.8M, or −$0.13 per share, from $8.1M. Operating cash flow was −$9.0M and free cash flow −$14.1M, versus −$5.8M.
sources: Richtech Robotics Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
